permission.outcomeExpired: Timed out. {source} was told it was cancelled
permission.outcomeDeliveryFailed: Could not send the decision. Please handle it in {source}
permission.outcomeConflict: This request can no longer be answered here. Please go back to {source}
permission.outcomeError: Something went wrong sending the decision. Try again, or handle it in {source}
permission.noticeTitleMulti: {count} agents are waiting for your approval
permission.noticeWhereApp: Go back to the {source} desktop app to handle it
permission.noticeExternalOnly: This agent's permission requests can only be answered in its original tool.
permission.noticeHelpLabel: Why can't I approve this here?
permission.noticeExplain: Codex and Claude only tell Agent Pets that they are waiting for permission and give no way to send a decision back, so it cannot be approved here. Only OpenCode can be approved directly from the pet bubble.
permission.notifyExternal: {source} is waiting for approval (go back to its tool)
permission.settingsIntro: Which agents' permission requests can be handled right from the pet bubble:
permission.settingsReminderOnly: Reminder only; answer in the original tool
permission.settingsRiskRules: Risk is judged conservatively: only read-only tools such as read and search count as low risk, every other tool is treated as high risk, and high-risk requests cannot be approved with the global shortcut.
